posts.title: An open Android app for the Geek szitman USB endoscope
posts.description: I have one of those cheap Chinese USB endoscopes. The stickers on it say J106 and J108 (yes, two different ones), and on USB it shows up as: ID 2ce3:3828 Geek szitman supercamera It looks like a webcam, but it isn’t one. It does not implement UVC, so no camera app on any system recognises it. The only official way to use it is a closed vendor app for Android and iOS, which I would rather not have

posts.title: Immich Pi Photo Frame
posts.description: My photos live on a self-hosted Immich server. It is great for browsing and backups, but the photos rarely get looked at unless someone opens the app. So I built a small photo frame around an original Raspberry Pi Model A+ that shows photos from selected Immich albums. posts.title: Bor: My Side Project
